description: This file is a PHP source file that generates an HTML page providing a user interface for resetting and restoring a gateway device. It includes HTML, PHP includes, JavaScript for handling user actions, and inline PHP for session-based conditions.

methods.name: setResetInfo
methods.description: Sends an AJAX request to initiate a reset or restore operation on the gateway, handling reboot or Wi-Fi restart based on server response.

methods.name: checkForRebooting
methods.description: Periodically checks if the device has rebooted by attempting to load index.php, redirecting to login page upon success.
